status: research dataset only; not site data. Every figure is the L3323 rule applied to stored values, not a measured result.
assumptions: Damage per hit = stored direct damage x grid value + stored blast damage x the blast material's grid value, at close range and full blast (L3323, L3327).
Stored damage is the registry default where a row exists, otherwise the asset's own value.

For target material 119 four figures are given: turret 75%, body 100%, side 150%, rear 200% on the direct part (EA 1.3.1.0). Applying these steps to IFVs, the Gepard and armoured cars is an assumption.

Health is the stored root value Class_f2a56983.Field_9040392c. Effective health is not established (VEHICLES.md, L3024 and L3041); the Abrams and Leopard store 1200 while EA's and creators' figures treat a tank as 1000, so hitsIfHealth1000 is given for those two.
Mobile anti-air rounds against aircraft are doubled, because EA's figures are twice the rule (L3322).
No repair, no active protection, no upgrade (the durability upgrade stores 0.85), no falloff with range, no partial blast.
The SLAM row adds EFP and body explosion and does not reproduce EA's SLAM figures.
EA item names are joined to owners by name only; the two bombs are listed by file name (see L3327).
